setup.title: Welcome! Let’s get your first workshop ready
setup.description: Just a few short steps. As soon as things get going, your figures and charts will appear right here.

category.title: Add a category
category.description: Group your workshops, for example candle making or ceramics.

instructor.title: Add an instructor
instructor.description: Their profile is shown on the site and used in the contract.

contract.title: Set the contract text
contract.description: This contract is emailed to the instructor for every workshop.

workshop.title: Create a workshop
workshop.description: Date, venue, number of places and price. The contract goes out by email.

capital.title: Record the starting capital
capital.description: Add what each partner puts into the shared wallet.

attention.title: Needs your attention
attention.decisions: {count, plural, one {# go / no-go decision is due} other {# go / no-go decisions are due}}
attention.signatures: {count, plural, one {# contract is waiting to be signed} other {# contracts are waiting to be signed}}
attention.toClose: {count, plural, one {# workshop is ready to close} other {# workshops are ready to close}}

kpi.walletHint: Cash in the shared wallet right now
kpi.walletNegative: The wallet is below zero. Please check the latest entries.
kpi.netHint: Since 1 January. An instructor’s fee counts once the workshop is closed.
kpi.upcomingNotOpen: Waiting for contracts to be signed

revenue.title: Revenue, expenses and profit
revenue.description: The last 12 months, by the date each entry was recorded. An instructor’s fee counts on the day the workshop is closed.
revenue.tableCaption: Revenue, expenses and net profit per month

empty.title: No income or expenses yet
empty.description: As soon as money comes in or goes out, you’ll see it here month by month.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Each partner’s share of the profit and their capital
partners.sharesOff: The shares add up to {total}, not 100%. Workshops can’t be closed until this is fixed.

empty.title: No profit shares yet
empty.description: Set each partner’s share, so every workshop’s profit can be split fairly.

upcoming.title: Upcoming workshops
upcoming.description: The next workshops at a glance

alerts.awaitingSignature: Waiting for the instructor to sign the contract
alerts.decisionDue: Time for the go / no-go decision
alerts.missing: {count, plural, one {# more person needed for the minimum} other {# more people needed for the minimum}}

empty.title: No upcoming workshops
empty.description: Plan the next one, and it will show up here with its registrations.
